name: Summer Session Discount Program for High School Students
what_you_do: Take real UC Merced college classes in summer, online or in person, at a lower price. The credit and grade can transfer to other colleges.
who_can_apply: Students who will be high school juniors or seniors in the fall. You need a letter from your school counselor or an administrator saying you are in good standing.
pay_detail: $220 per unit. One 4-unit course costs $880. The application fee and campus fees are waived.
duration: One summer session course or more
deadline_text: The 2027 dates are not posted. Last year, the application opened Apr 27, 2026 and course enrollment opened May 19, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the discount program application. Attach an unofficial high school transcript (a phone photo is fine) and the counselor or administrator letter. Add a college transcript if you took a needed college class. Then claim your UC Merced email and sign up for open classes.
notes: Not a job. You can only take classes with no prerequisites, or ones whose prerequisites you have finished. Pay the bill by the end of the first day of class. Questions: summersession@ucmerced.edu.
